scopeLimits: Only POST grants, DELETE grant and their private revokeGrant helper change. Staff handlers, schemas, policies and migrations retain exact bytes; staff removal calls the upgraded helper and is rerun in full.

Existing staff/grant row locks, deterministic staff ordering, 1-168h statement_timestamp expiry, clock_timestamp status/revocation, public13-field DTO, append-only history and audit causes remain unchanged.

New materialized guards protect writes; fresh statements recheck MFA after row waits, updates including zero-row/idempotent outcomes and audits, plus the whole grant transaction. No universal race-freedom claim beyond the observed boundaries.

All99 new independent cases use real HTTP login/enrollment/TOTP in the same bearer/session family. SQL only seeds explicit historical fixtures and negative factor/proof/catalog changes, never positive proof.
Baseline68 divergences:24 statuses201,20 statuses204,16 statuses400 and8 statuses404 versus403. Exact preceding data/DTO/audit/access checks are required for every baseline diagnostic.

44 interleavings follow actual support:grant authorization.16 further cases observe a real restricted app connection blocked by the owner on staff or grant rows. Each poll clears its statistics snapshot; proof/factor withdrawal and lock release commit together. Two cases also commit a concurrent owner revocation; no app audit or row change is expected for that zero-row outcome.

14 positive cases cover flag/global-binding authority, minimum/maximum hours, all five allowed capabilities, multicap replacements and duplicate staff, open/expired/already-revoked grants and repeat idempotence. Same bearer gains/loses telemetry; foreign building access remains denied.

Eight narrow proof-removing triggers and eight generic exceptions cover INSERT, UPDATE, created/revoked audits. Multicap replacement fails on the second capability to prove prior changes roll back. Exact account/bindings/grants/audit and original proof timestamp/generation are checked; sequence witnesses survive rollback.

Three zero-row trigger cases preserve INSERT500 rollback and DELETE204 without audit/mutation. Schema bounds, eligibility/windows/local scope, self/missing/inactive building, unauthenticated/local/resident/staff refusals and password-recency contract are tested.

Partial authority is an explicit negative catalog fixture: remove PLATFORM_ADMIN support:grant permission, preserve rbac:manage, refuse direct grant commands and remove staff without touching legacy grants; same bearer loses telemetry; restore exact permission row. This is not support for arbitrary custom global roles.

Six unchanged regression files yield103 TAP/99 independent cases/four aggregate groups, including actual simultaneous first grants, all36 staff creation and35 staff removal cases. Historical read cases retain direct-SQL proof limitations; earlier runs are not added.

The first regression attempt is preserved as an infrastructure failure after Windows Idle Timeout standby. Its partial passes are not counted. Owned controller/database recovery restored documented initial NOLOGIN/no-password roles with identical role OIDs. All six unchanged files were rerun with identical executor bytes and deadlines in a fresh database; temporary system activity request was cleared afterward.

MFA policy068 remains candidate; runtime main001-067 is unchanged. Other domains, historical inactive-staff grant reconciliation, private cache, full API/ingest/browser/native Android/iOS, performance, operations and final demonstrations remain pending.
